description: The pie chart represents the distribution of time or proportion between two categories. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction", is colored orange and occupies approximately 69.92% of the chart, corresponding to 60.9 seconds. The smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment", is colored blue and accounts for around 30.08% of the chart, corresponding to 26.2 seconds. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and one slice is visually emphasized by being offset or "exploded" from the rest of the chart, specifically the "Efficient deployment" slice. No legend is present in the chart.
